turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, music was just better when I was young.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lots of people feel that. The music from your teens often sticks with us the most, because it's tied to so many big moments.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I live in a small flat and work long hours, but I'd really love some kind of pet.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to read out a few choices, and I'll let you know when I've finished.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I keep coming back to a cat, independent and cuddly, but my landlord would need to agree.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A pair of budgies would be cheerful and fit in a corner, though they can be pretty noisy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's also a fish tank, very calm and nice to look at, but you can't exactly cuddle a fish.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could skip owning and volunteer walking dogs at the shelter on weekends.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Go on, rip them apart.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If what you want is cuddles, the cat or the shelter walks are your real options. The volunteering is a great way to start without the commitment, and it'll show you how much time you really have.
